name: Potential CobaltStrike Process Patterns
description: Detects potential process patterns related to Cobalt Strike beacon activity
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.command_line:*cmd.exe\ \/C\ whoami AND process.parent.executable:C\:\\Temp\\*) OR ((process.parent.executable:(*\\runonce.exe OR *\\dllhost.exe)) AND (process.command_line:*cmd.exe\ \/c\ echo* AND process.command_line:*\>\ \\\\.\\pipe*)) OR ((process.parent.command_line:*cmd.exe\ \/C\ echo* AND process.parent.command_line:*\ \>\ \\\\.\\pipe*) AND process.command_line:*conhost.exe\ 0xffffffff\ \-ForceV1) OR (process.parent.command_line:*\/C\ whoami AND process.command_line:*conhost.exe\ 0xffffffff\ \-ForceV1)
